prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In & Protect Your Pet Cloud Save", "Your pets and progress will be synced to your account automatically.", "Cloud Auto-Sync Active"]
1: ["How to Interact with Your Desktop Pet", "Right-click your pet for controls, or drag your pet anywhere across screens.", "Right-click = Pet Menu & Hide | Click + Drag = Reposition on Screen"]
2: ["Preview and Pick Your Buddy", "Listen to Pet Sound"]
3: ["Choose Your Pet's Playstyle", "Select whether you want a calm background companion or an active interactive buddy.", "Select Companion Type"]
4: ["Preparing Desktop Overlay", "Ensuring desktop pet display permissions are enabled on your computer.", "Desktop Overlay Verified"]
5: ["Upload Photo for Custom Pet", "If custom photo generation fails, we automatically generate a polished fallback pet so your setup is never blocked.", "Supports PNG or JPG up to 10MB."]
6: ["Signing in connects your pet cloud save automatically without deleting existing pets."]
7: ["Play Pet Idle Sound"]
8: ["Your Pet is Ready to Play!", "Launch Pet to Desktop"]
9: ["Includes Free Starter Toy Gift"]
